features.name: Double Escape
features.text: Press Esc twice to leave a page's full screen

features.name: AI Video Summary
features.text: Summarize a video: summary, chapters, and transcript in chat; timestamps jump the video

features.name: Video Speed Range
features.text: Video speed from 1/16× to 16×

features.name: Video Default Speed
features.text: Back to default speed: one press returns a video to your usual speed

features.name: Image Text
features.text: Text in images: select, copy, and find text in images, recognized on this Mac

features.name: Read Aloud
features.text: Read aloud: listen to a page with a mini player, on this Mac

features.name: Dictation
features.text: Dictation: hold Fn to dictate into the focused field, on this Mac

features.name: Media Settings
features.text: Settings › Media: speed, captions, summaries, read aloud, and dictation in one page

features.name: Routines
features.text: Routines: AI runs on a schedule or a trigger and leaves results in Updates and a thread

features.name: Command Bar Numbers
features.text: ⌘1–⌘9 pick a row while the command bar is open; hold ⌘ to see the numbers

features.name: Command Bar VPN Strip
features.text: VPN status strip along the bottom of the command bar's results while the VPN is on

features.name: Annotations
features.text: Annotations: highlight passages in four colors and keep a note on any page

features.name: Meeting Notes
features.text: Meeting notes: Granola's key points in chat during calendar meetings, or Whimsy's own notes when Granola can't help

features.name: Hover Cards
features.text: Hover cards: rest on a tab or a link to see a picture, its title and address, and an AI description

features.name: Passkeys
features.text: Passkeys with Touch ID, held by Whimsy in the Secure Enclave

features.name: Restart Command
features.text: Restart Whimsy: a command that quits and reopens with every window and tab restored

features.name: Page Animations Command
features.text: Turn Off Page Animations: a command that stops CSS animations and transitions on the current tab until it reloads

features.name: Window Title Space
features.text: Show space name in window title: "<space> — <page title>" (Settings → Tab Management, off by default)
